universities.name: Politecnico di Bari
universities.research_summary: Politecnico di Bari's official 2026/27 Computer Engineering MSc is Class LM-32, two years/120 ECTS and taught in English, with curricula in AI and Data Science, Cybersecurity and Cloud, and Cyberphysical Systems. Applicants needed a suitable bachelor's degree, at least 48 ECTS across listed engineering, computer-science, mathematics and related areas, adequate individual preparation and English B2; any curricular integrations had to be completed before entry. The mandatory Esse3 application had multiple 2026/27 windows and had to precede the later enrollment period. Foreign qualifications required document and authenticity checks; applicants needing a visa also used Universitaly. The 2026/27 tuition contribution varied by ISEE and merit/study-progress eligibility: the fee regulation sets no-tax-area criteria and a €2,257.60 contribution cap for high or absent eligible ISEE, plus regional tax and stamp duty. ADISU Puglia aid was an annual competitive call, while the Poliba international award reviewed was restricted to one already-admitted Palestinian student resident in Gaza. No new 2027/28 Computer Engineering first-year call or terms were found; the published February 2027 notice concerns first-level courses only.

universities.name: Politecnico di Milano
universities.research_summary: Politecnico di Milano's 2026/27 official catalogue lists the prior-cycle degree identities for the reviewed legacy candidates. Computer Science and Engineering is a two-year English MSc and its Artificial Intelligence option is a study plan, not a separate catalogue degree. High Performance Computing Engineering is a separate English MSc; its reviewed profile specifies 20 ECTS in computing, 20 in mathematics/statistics and 10 in physics. Biomedical Engineering is separately offered as a BSc in Italian and an MSc in Italian or English. Architecture and Communication Design MScs are listed in Italian or English, while the BSc Progettazione dell'Architettura is also listed in Italian or English. Mechanical Engineering and Design & Engineering profile pages explicitly refer to 2025/26 information and may change in later years. The generic Aerospace Engineering MSc lead was not matched to a standalone catalogue entry: official pages distinguish Aeronautical Engineering MSc, Space Engineering MSc and Aerospace Engineering BSc, so the record remains unresolved. The Computer Science and Engineering (T2A) and High Performance Computing Engineering MScs now have core details and first-year entry confirmed for 2027/28 only through an assigned 28DIGITAL pathway, with a separate local Polimi application and English proof. Italian-degree applicants are invited to apply locally in July-August 2027; exact days are due in spring. The remaining 15 candidate first-year offers are still pending because current MSc catalogue/calendar sources are university-level and do not name those programmes. Engineering admissions pages state that the 2027/28 BSc call would follow, while the general MSc Engineering deadlines contain a label/date inconsistency. The current tuition page still covers 2026/27; course-wide requirements and 2027/28 tuition/scholarships remain open.

source_urls.title: Deadlines – Admission to Laurea Magistrale with foreign qualification
source_urls.evidence: For September 2027 MSc entry, the page gives general 2027/28 windows of 1 Oct–1 Dec 2026 (early bird), 12–28 Jan 2027 and 1–18 Mar 2027 for EEA and certain non-EEA residents in Italy. Architecture/Design has its own table with a 1 Oct 2026–28 Jan 2027 general call and the same additional March call. A separate Engineering subsection labelled 2026/27 nevertheless describes the September 2027 intake and gives 12 Jan–25 Feb 2027, creating a cycle/date discrepancy that must be resolved by study area. Fees are €50 early bird or €150 standard, and candidates may apply to at most two programmes.

universities.name: Politecnico di Torino
universities.research_summary: Politecnico di Torino's official 2026/27 Master's catalogue and course profiles were checked against all eight legacy candidates. Computer Engineering is Italian and English; Aerospace Engineering is Italian; Architecture Construction City is Italian and English; and the current title for the legacy ICT for Smart Societies row is ICT Engineering for Smart Societies (English). The other matched candidates are English-taught. Profiles identify a two-year, 120-ECTS MSc structure, course codes and campuses; the 2026/27 foreign-applicant annex supplies recommended backgrounds and IELTS 5.5 minima for the English routes. Those backgrounds are explicitly recommendations, not binding minimum entry conditions. The foreign-admissions page gives a first-cycle qualification, suitable academic performance, course-specific curricular review, and B2 language rules. Its 2026/27 dates and €50 application fee are retained as historical evidence only. The current fee page links 2026/27 tuition regulations and EDISU aid; no 2027/28 fee schedule or scholarship award was confirmed. An additional interdisciplinary English MSc, Digital Skills for Sustainable Societal Transitions, was identified because the official 2026/27 admissions annex lists Information Technology and Computer Sciences among its recommended backgrounds; it is not a conventional Computer Science degree. For this candidate, the 2026/27 Italian-qualification pages additionally confirm first- and second-semester entry routes, class and credit-group eligibility, academic thresholds, English B2 and scheduled admission-test dates; the amount of the domestic-route application fee was not found. The checked named course profiles are for 2026/27, so all nine course-level 2027/28 first-year offers and current admission, fee and scholarship terms remain unverified. No official acceptance-rate denominator and admitted count were found.

The first 28DIGITAL period deadline is 31 Jan 2027; later periods depend on available places.

official_program_source_urls.title: HySET admission requirements
official_program_source_urls.evidence: Requires a relevant bachelor’s degree of at least 180 ECTS in listed engineering/science fields; minimum English evidence is TOEFL iBT 90 with at least 21 in each section, IELTS 6.5 overall with at least 6.0 each section, or Cambridge 160 (higher threshold for a TU/e destination). Selection is scored on academic achievements, background relevance, references/video, and experience. The current page states a 2027–29 call is open.

official_program_source_urls.title: Medicine and Surgery F – AY 2026/27 admission call
official_program_source_urls.evidence: The 2026/27 Sapienza call for the English-language Medicine and Surgery F course states 52 places for Italian/EU/equivalent applicants and 13 for non-EU residents abroad. Universitaly registration ran 26 August–9 September 2026 at 15:00 Rome time; the in-person test was 29 September. It required a secondary-school diploma obtained or to be obtained in 2026, plus the separate visa-pre-enrolment route by 30 June for non-EU applicants resident abroad. The test comprised 60 questions in 100 minutes, scored +1.5 correct, −0.4 incorrect and 0 blank; the ranking threshold was at least 20 for Italian/EU/equivalent applicants and above zero for non-EU residents abroad. Listed language certificates are tie-break evidence, not a separately stated minimum entry requirement. The call requires a test contribution through Universitaly but does not state its amount. official_program_source_urls.title: Medicine and Surgery – AY 2026/27 open-semester procedure
official_program_source_urls.evidence: Sapienza's 2026/27 open-semester guidance concerns its Italian-taught Medicine and Surgery routes: three 6-CFU foundation courses (Biology, Chemistry and Biochemical Preparations, Physics); Universitaly registration 13 July–3 August 2026 at 18:00, followed by Sapienza payment by 6 August; compulsory attendance; and national ranking after exam sessions on 10 December 2026 and 11 January 2027. The semester contribution is €250, reduced to €200 for qualifying ISEE between €22,000 and €30,000, with specified total exemptions including ISEE up to €22,000, disability/invalidity at least 66%, DiSCo eligibility/award and MAECI award. official_program_source_urls.title: Bicocca International Scholarship Programme – call AY 2026/27
official_program_source_urls.evidence: The 2026/27 call reserves eligibility for international students residing abroad with foreign qualifications. It lists Data Science, International Economics, Artificial Intelligence for Science and Technology, Astrophysics and Space Physics, and Human-Centered Artificial Intelligence among participating Master's courses. It assigns five competitive awards per listed course, each worth €10,000 gross per academic year plus a tuition-fee exemption; administrative and regional fees remain payable. The call's separate undergraduate entry uses the wording 'Artificial Science (LT)', so the BSc Artificial Intelligence lead is not matched to that award here.

official_program_source_urls.title: Student contribution fees AY 2026/27
official_program_source_urls.evidence: For 2026/27, the University expanded its ISEE no-tax area to €30,000 subject to merit criteria. No 2027/28 fee schedule was identified.

These are prior-cycle, category-specific terms.
